findings.source_quote: The text of this hymn, All Hail the Power of Jesus Name, has been translated into almost every language where Christianity is known.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the hymn title into Afrikaans where it appears in running text, matching the translated title used elsewhere. For example: "Die teks van hierdie gesang, Ere aan die Naam van Jesus toe!, is in byna elke taal vertaal ..." Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Die teks van hierdie gesang, All Hail the Power of Jesus Name, is in byna elke taal vertaal waar Christusendom bekend is.
